metadata.title: YouTube Short Storyboard — Marketing reporting takes too long

scenes.name: Hook

visual_cues.description: Bold text on dark/black background — "Marketing reporting takes too long"
visual_cues.animation: Fast zoom-in, dramatic music sting, slight shake effect

scenes.music: Dramatic intro sting, then cuts to background track

scenes.name: Problem Agitation

visual_cues.description: Split screen or quick cuts — messy folders, multiple browser tabs, frustrated person at desk
visual_cues.text_overlay: 2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads.
visual_cues.animation: Quick cuts every 2-3 seconds, slight desaturation for 'problem' mood
visual_cues.screen_recording: Screen recording of messy file folders or disconnected apps (optional)

scenes.voiceover: Reporting takes days of manual spreadsheet work and is often outdated by delivery. 2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads.
scenes.text_overlay: 2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads.

scenes.name: Solution

visual_cues.description: Clean dashboard interface, organized asset library, automated workflow diagram. Screen recording of Dashboards system in action.
visual_cues.text_overlay: One dashboard that tells you exactly what's working
visual_cues.animation: Smooth pan across dashboard, zoom into key features, before/after transition
visual_cues.screen_recording: Record Dashboards dashboard demo — show the actual system working. Use OBS Studio. 15-20 second clip.

before_after.before: Messy, scattered assets / manual posting / no dashboard
before_after.after: Clean, organized Dashboards system — automated, visual, connected

scenes.voiceover: If you can't measure it, you can't improve it. Unified dashboards that tell you what's actually working. M.O.T Innovation builds Performance Tracking & Reporting. One dashboard that tells you exactly what's working.
scenes.text_overlay: One dashboard that tells you exactly what's working
scenes.music: Uplifting, professional background track — more energy

case_study_overlay.result: 80% reduction in time-to-publish. Clear view of which channels actually drove sales.
case_study_overlay.animation: Slide in from right, hold 3 seconds

scenes.name: CTA

visual_cues.description: M.O.T Innovation logo on dark background with website URL and CTA button
visual_cues.animation: Logo fades in, text slides up, subtle pulse on CTA

scenes.voiceover: Book a free consultation at motinnovation.co.za. We don't build slide decks — we build working systems. Link in the description.
scenes.music: Music swells then resolves on final beat

steps.details: Download stock footage from Pexels (links in storyboard JSON). Record screen for Solution section using OBS Studio.
Import the generated MP3 voiceover from audio/ directory. Align voiceover to scene timings.
Scene 1 (0-5s): Dark background text clip. Scene 2 (5-15s): Problem stock footage. Scene 3 (15-45s): Screen recording + solution stock footage. Scene 4 (45-60s): Logo + CTA card.
Scene 1→2: Hard cut. Scene 2→3: Whip pan transition. Scene 3→4: Fade to black then logo fade-in.

Scene 1: "Marketing reporting takes too long" (center, large, white on black). Scene 2: "2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads." (bottom third). Scene 3: "One dashboard that tells you exactly what's working" (top third). Scene 4: "Book a Free Consultation" + URL (center).

text_overlays.text: 2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads.
One dashboard that tells you exactly what's working

steps.details: Background track: professional, building energy. Scene 1: dramatic sting. Scene 2: tense. Scene 3: uplifting. Scene 4: resolve. Use CapCut's free audio library or import royalty-free track.
Use CapCut's Auto Caption feature (free). Set to English. Style: white text with black outline, bottom center. This is critical for faceless content engagement.
Export as MP4, 1080x1920, 30fps, H.264. File size target: <100MB for YouTube Shorts upload.

thumbnail_design.dimensions: 1280x720 (YouTube thumbnail) — also create 1080x1920 version for Shorts cover

design_elements.spec: Dark charcoal (#0a0a0a) with subtle gradient or grain texture
"2+ days/month spent building reports nobody reads." — Bold, large, white text, centered. Font: Montserrat Bold or similar.
"Marketing reporting takes too long" — Smaller, gray (#999), below main text.
M.O.T Innovation logo, bottom right corner, small
Thin accent line or geometric shape in brand accent color (white or electric blue)

thumbnail_design.canva_search: Search Canva for 'dark minimalist YouTube thumbnail' template
thumbnail_design.style_notes: Minimalist, high contrast. No clutter. The stat text should be readable at thumbnail size.
